title: A brief history of the Bloomberg terminal

paragraphs.en: It gave Wall Street traders and analysts an unprecedented window on global markets
paragraphs.zh: 它为华尔街的交易员和分析师提供了一个前所未有的观察全球市场的窗口

paragraphs.en: Allison Marsh is a professor at the University of South Carolina and the codirector of the Ann Johnson Institute for Science, Technology & Society.
paragraphs.zh: Allison Marsh 是南卡罗来纳大学的教授，也是 Ann Johnson 科学、技术与社会研究所的联合主任。

paragraphs.en: This early 1990s keyboard for the Bloomberg Terminal featured a trackball, speaker, and headphone and microphone ports.
paragraphs.zh: 这款1990年代初期的彭博终端键盘配备了轨迹球、扬声器以及耳机和麦克风接口。

paragraphs.en: Financial markets have always relied on timely information, and the drive for timeliness has always adapted to the latest technology. From clipper ships transiting the oceans to telegraph wires connecting cities to fiber-optic cables conducting trades in microseconds , traders have embraced any advantage to get the most up-to-date information. Indeed, the history of finance is really a story about how fast you can move information and who controls the interface.
paragraphs.zh: 金融市场历来依赖及时的信息，而对及时性的追求始终与时俱进，适应最新的技术。 从穿越大洋的飞剪式帆船，到连接城市的电报线路，再到以微秒速度执行交易的光纤电缆，交易者们总是乐于利用任何优势来获取最新的信息。 事实上，金融的历史就是一部关于信息传递速度有多快、以及由谁掌控交互界面的故事。

paragraphs.en: It’s only natural that people also figured out a way to profit by supplying that market intel. In 1841, for example, the Mercantile Exchange (predecessor to Dun & Bradstreet) began selling proprietary business information to its U.S. clients. The following decade, Paul Julius Reuter began selling news services and stock price information. To supplement the company’s telegraph dispatches, he sent pigeons between Aachen, Germany, and Brussels; each bird carried a cylinder containing slips of paper with that day’s stock prices. In 1867, an inventor named Edward Calahan introduced the first telegraphic ticker-tape machine, which spooled out stock price information in near real time; Thomas Edison improved upon the design with his patented version in 1871.
paragraphs.zh: 人们自然会想出通过提供这种市场情报来获利的方法。 例如，1841 年，商业交易所（邓白氏公司前身）开始向其美国客户出售专有商业信息。 接下来的十年里，保罗·朱利叶斯·路透开始出售新闻服务和股票价格信息。 为补充公司的电报快讯，他在德国亚琛与布鲁塞尔之间放飞信鸽；每只信鸽都携带着一个圆筒，筒内装有写着当天股票价格的纸条。 1867 年，一位名叫爱德华·卡拉汉的发明家推出了第一台电报式股票行情收报机，可以近乎实时地输出股票价格信息；托马斯·爱迪生于 1871 年以自己获得专利的设计对其加以改进。

paragraphs.en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average debuted in 1896 as an index of 12 key businesses listed on U.S. stock exchanges. It included gas, oil, coal, and electric companies, as well as enterprises dealing in leather, rubber, and tobacco. Messengers delivered quotes from the trading floor to brokerage offices, while stock tickers kept investors informed of prices. By the time New York City held its first official ticker-tape parade , in 1919, telegraphy in Western Europe and the United States had become the chief means for quick transmission of vital stock information.
paragraphs.zh: 道琼斯工业平均指数于1896年首次发布，是一个由在美国证券交易所上市的12家关键企业组成的指数。 其中包括天然气、石油、煤炭和电力公司，以及经营皮革、橡胶和烟草的企业。 信使将交易大厅的报价送到经纪公司办公室，同时股票报价机让投资者及时了解价格信息。 到1919年纽约市举行首次正式的彩带游行时，电报技术已成为西欧和美国快速传递重要股票信息的主要手段。

paragraphs.en: In 1960, the first paperless financial service debuted, when Quotron introduced its electronic screens for displaying market quotes. Over the next two decades, other companies rolled out similar innovations for distributing financial news and data.
paragraphs.zh: 1960年，首个无纸化金融服务问世，Quotron推出了用于显示市场报价的电子屏幕。 在接下来的二十年里，其他公司也陆续推出了用于分发金融新闻和数据的类似创新产品。

sents.zh: 1960年，首个无纸化金融服务问世，Quotron推出了用于显示市场报价的电子屏幕。

sents.zh: 在接下来的二十年里，其他公司也陆续推出了用于分发金融新闻和数据的类似创新产品。

paragraphs.en: So when Michael Bloomberg decided to enter this well-established industry in 1981, the big question was: How would his new company stand out?
paragraphs.zh: 所以当迈克尔·布隆伯格在1981年决定进入这个成熟的行业时，最大的问题是：他的新公司该如何脱颖而出？

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg had cofounded Innovative Market Systems (IMS) after being fired from the investment bank Salomon Brothers. Landing on his feet with his US $10 million equity payout and joined by former Salomon colleagues Thomas Secunda, Duncan MacMillan, and Charles Zegar, Bloomberg pursued his belief that Wall Street would pay a premium for specialized financial data. He’d earned an electrical engineering degree from Johns Hopkins University and an MBA from Harvard, and he’d built computerized financial systems for Salomon. IMS focused on developing a computer terminal that not only provided up-to-date information but could also do instant quantitative analysis based on historical data.
paragraphs.zh: 布隆伯格在被投行所罗门兄弟解雇后，与人共同创立了创新市场系统公司（IMS）。 他拿着一千万美元的股权补偿金重新站稳脚跟，并联合了前所罗门同事托马斯·塞昆达、邓肯·麦克米伦和查尔斯·泽加尔，坚信华尔街会为专业金融数据支付溢价。 他拥有约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的电气工程学位和哈佛大学的 MBA，并曾为所罗门兄弟构建计算机化的金融系统。 IMS 专注于开发一种计算机终端，它不仅能提供最新信息，还能基于历史数据进行即时定量分析。

paragraphs.en: At the time, most financial data still circulated through telephone calls, printed price sheets, and specialist publications, and analysis involved a fair amount of gut instinct guided by human expertise. Companies such as Reuters and Dow Jones provided subscription-based services for access to business news. But traders still had to assemble information from multiple sources and perform their own calculations and analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 当时，大多数金融数据仍通过电话、印刷价格表和专业出版物传播，分析在很大程度上依赖由人类专业知识指导的直觉判断。 路透社和道琼斯等公司提供基于订阅的服务，用于获取商业新闻。 但交易员仍需从多个来源汇集信息，并自行进行计算和分析。

paragraphs.en: IMS proposed an integrated system with a single interface. Its Market Master terminal consisted of a monochrome CRT monitor, a custom keyboard, and a communications/controller unit that connected to the company’s private network. At launch , it provided only U.S. government bond prices and bond-calculation tools, but the dream was much bigger: a dedicated terminal that would sit on a trader’s desk and run different market scenarios, produce yield curves, and support investment calculations.
paragraphs.zh: IMS 提出了一个具有单一界面的集成系统。 其 Market Master 终端由一台单色 CRT 显示器、一个定制键盘以及一个连接到公司专用网络的通信/控制单元组成。 在发布时，它只提供美国政府债券价格和债券计算工具，但梦想要宏大得多：一个摆放在交易员桌上的专用终端，可以运行不同的市场情景、生成收益率曲线并支持投资计算。

sents.en: IMS proposed an integrated system with a single interface.
sents.zh: IMS 提出了一个具有单一界面的集成系统。

sents.en: Its Market Master terminal consisted of a monochrome CRT monitor, a custom keyboard, and a communications/controller unit that connected to the company’s private network.
sents.zh: 其 Market Master 终端由一台单色 CRT 显示器、一个定制键盘以及一个连接到公司专用网络的通信/控制单元组成。

sents.en: At launch , it provided only U.S. government bond prices and bond-calculation tools, but the dream was much bigger: a dedicated terminal that would sit on a trader’s desk and run different market scenarios, produce yield curves, and support investment calculations.
sents.zh: 在发布时，它只提供美国政府债券价格和债券计算工具，但梦想要宏大得多：一个摆放在交易员桌上的专用终端，可以运行不同的市场情景、生成收益率曲线并支持投资计算。

paragraphs.en: IMS initially had just one client, Merrill Lynch, which invested $30 million (about $110 million today) in exchange for a 30 percent stake in the company and exclusive rights to the terminals for five years; Merrill waived that right in 1984. The first 22 Market Master terminals were delivered to Merrill in 1982, in the middle of a global recession . The timing was fortuitous. Worldwide, stock markets were transitioning to electronic trading, and the U.S. Federal Reserve was allowing more freely floating interest rates. Bond prices were more volatile, and investors were eager to figure out how to value them accurately. Bloomberg’s specialized financial terminals provided the data and the analytical tools to process and comprehend those sweeping changes.
paragraphs.zh: IMS起初只有一个客户——美林证券，该公司投入3000万美元（约合今天的1.1亿美元），换取公司30%的股份以及终端五年的独家使用权；美林于1984年放弃了这一权利。 最初的22台Market Master终端于1982年交付给美林，当时正值全球经济衰退中期。 这个时机纯属偶然。 全世界的股票市场正在向电子交易转型，而美国 美联储正在允许利率更加自由地浮动。 债券价格波动加剧，投资者迫切想知道如何准确地为债券估值。 布隆伯格的专业金融终端提供了处理和理解这些巨大变革所需的数据和分析工具。

paragraphs.en: Five years after its launch, IMS rebranded as Bloomberg LP and expanded its clientele, and the Market Master became known as the Bloomberg Terminal.
paragraphs.zh: 成立五年后，IMS 更名为 Bloomberg LP，并扩大了其客户群，而 Market Master（市场大师）则被称为 Bloomberg Terminal（彭博终端）。

paragraphs.en: The Bloomberg Terminal’s keyboard was designed with traders and analysts in mind. The function keys were color-coded and given labels specifying their usage, so that users didn’t have to remember. The original keyboard, affectionately referred to as “ the Chiclet ,” was hand assembled. A cable ran from the keyboard to the Bloomberg Controller, which had a dedicated phone line to connect to a local hub. The internet wasn’t commercially available yet, so the company basically built its own closed network, with centralized computers that maintained large databases and performed most of the calculations. Commands entered on the keyboard sent a request to the hub, which processed the information and sent back the result.
paragraphs.zh: 彭博终端的键盘是为交易员和分析师量身设计的。 功能键以颜色区分，并带有标明用途的标签，用户无需记忆。 最初的键盘被亲切地称为“Chiclet”（软糖键），是手工组装的。 键盘通过一根线缆连接到彭博控制器，该控制器有专用电话线连接到本地集线器。 互联网当时尚未商用，因此公司基本上自建了一个封闭网络，由集中式计算机维护大型数据库并执行大部分计算。 在键盘上输入的命令会向集线器发送请求，集线器处理信息后将结果传回。

paragraphs.en: Hot keys let traders easily call up data on government securities, corporate debt, and currency markets, among other things. A series of keystrokes would pull up other historical and real-time data, run an analysis, or place a trade. Learning how to use the terminal and digest the vast amount of information, which was presented mostly in tabular form, became a rite of passage for users.
paragraphs.zh: 热键让交易员可以轻松调取政府证券、公司债券和货币市场等各类数据。 一系列按键操作可以调出其他历史和实时数据、运行分析或执行交易。 学习如何使用终端并消化主要以表格形式呈现的海量信息，成为用户的一种必经仪式。

sents.en: Hot keys let traders easily call up data on government securities, corporate debt, and currency markets, among other things.
sents.zh: 热键让交易员可以轻松调取政府证券、公司债券和货币市场等各类数据。

sents.en: A series of keystrokes would pull up other historical and real-time data, run an analysis, or place a trade.
sents.zh: 一系列按键操作可以调出其他历史和实时数据、运行分析或执行交易。

sents.en: Learning how to use the terminal and digest the vast amount of information, which was presented mostly in tabular form, became a rite of passage for users.
sents.zh: 学习如何使用终端并消化主要以表格形式呈现的海量信息，成为用户的一种必经仪式。

paragraphs.en: In 1990, Bloomberg added a trackball to the keyboard, which helped the user navigate the multiple windows and menus typically displayed on screen. Two years later, the keyboard gained a built-in speaker, to support multimedia information; this design also included telephone, headphone, and microphone jacks. One of the most popular features was Instant Bloomberg, which allowed users to chat directly with fellow Bloomberg Terminal users over the proprietary network. By 1996, Bloomberg had keyboards that supported 23 different languages. In the early 2000s, the company began incorporating biometric authentication for terminal login, via a fingerprint reader on the keyboard.
paragraphs.zh: 1990年，彭博在键盘上加入了一个轨迹球，帮助用户在屏幕上通常显示的多个窗口和菜单之间进行导航。 两年后，键盘增加了内置扬声器，以支持多媒体信息；这一设计还包括电话、耳机和麦克风插孔。 最受欢迎的功能之一是Instant Bloomberg（即时彭博），它允许用户通过专有网络与其他彭博终端用户直接聊天。 到1996年，彭博的键盘已支持23种不同的语言。 21世纪初，公司开始通过键盘上的指纹读取器，为终端登录引入生物识别认证。

paragraphs.en: As the company’s business model evolved, the Bloomberg Terminal added services well beyond its initial offerings. In 1990, for example, worried that Dow Jones would stop providing access to its news stories, Bloomberg set up its own news service. It recruited Wall Street Journal reporter Matthew Winkler to oversee a dozen reporters; their stories on market and securities movements used graphs and calculations that served as advertisements for the terminal’s capabilities. These days, the Bloomberg news empire includes Bloomberg Businessweek , Bloomberg Radio , and Bloomberg Television .
paragraphs.zh: 随着公司商业模式的演变，彭博终端在其初始服务之外增加了许多新服务。 例如，1990 年，由于担心道琼斯会停止向其提供新闻报道的访问权限，彭博成立了自己的新闻服务。 公司聘请了《华尔街日报》记者马修·温克勒来管理十几名记者；他们撰写的关于市场和证券动态的报道使用了图表和计算，为终端的功能起到了广告宣传作用。 如今，彭博新闻帝国包括《彭博商业周刊》、彭博电台和彭博电视台。

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg’s subscription-based financial model included the leasing of a Bloomberg Terminal with its specialized keyboard and other hardware, access to a dedicated private network, and a suite of services. In 1999, a subscription to a single Bloomberg Terminal cost $1,600 per month with a minimum two-year contract and a discount on each additional terminal. Today the annual price is upwards of $32,000 (trending a little below inflation). In 1995, the company launched a suite of “Open Bloomberg” software products that ran on the customer’s own PC; five years later, it stopped leasing dedicated terminals. Current customers also have access to mobile applications that allow terminal functions to run on phones and tablets. Today, “Bloomberg Terminal” has come to refer to the integrated data, analytics, news, communications, and trading environment.
paragraphs.zh: 彭博基于订阅的金融商业模式包括出租配备专用键盘及其他硬件的彭博终端、提供专用私有网络的访问权限，以及一整套服务。 1999 年，订阅一台彭博终端的费用为每月 1,600 美元，需签订至少两年的合同，每增加一台终端可享受折扣。 如今，年费已超过 32,000 美元（涨幅略低于通货膨胀水平）。 1995 年，该公司推出了一套可在客户自己的个人电脑上运行的“开放彭博”软件产品；五年后，它停止了专用终端的租赁业务。 目前的客户还可以使用移动应用程序，使终端功能能够在手机和平板电脑上运行。 如今，“彭博终端”一词已泛指集数据、分析、新闻、通信和交易于一体的环境。

paragraphs.en: Although the shift away from dedicated terminals was a logical response to the rise of the internet and publicly available market data, it altered the material culture of financial work. For nearly two decades, Bloomberg Terminals commanded an aura of power and financial prowess. They were emblems of market mastery, with a brand that was distinct from other office computers. With Open Bloomberg, users were no longer tied to a single desk or a fixed set of monitors.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管从专用终端的转变是对互联网兴起和公开可得市场数据的合乎逻辑的回应，但它改变了金融工作的物质文化。 近二十年来，彭博终端一直笼罩着一种权力与金融实力的光环。 它们是驾驭市场的象征，其品牌也与其他办公电脑截然不同。 有了 Open Bloomberg，智能体（用户）不再被束缚在单一的办公桌或固定的一组显示器前。

paragraphs.en: And so, cast-off Bloomberg Terminals found their way into museum collections. They’re a physical embodiment of the ethereal nature of financial markets, and a manifestation of mathematical calculations, network infrastructure, and business culture.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，被淘汰的彭博终端最终进入了博物馆的收藏。 它们是金融市场虚无缥缈特质的具象化身，也是数学计算、网络基础设施和商业文化的具体呈现。

sents.en: National Museum of American History/Smithsonian Institution
sents.zh: 美国历史国家博物馆/史密森学会

paragraphs.en: The Smithsonian Institution’s National Museum of American History has a number of Bloomberg keyboards in its collection, but my favorite is object number 2014.0012.02 , which was used by “Bond King” Bill Gross during the 1990s and 2000s at Pacific Investment Management. Gross had cofounded PIMCO in 1971 and built it into a $2 trillion bond investment firm. I especially love that Gross taped his login and password directly on his keyboard, which makes the object more relatable. I may never know what it’s like to manage billions in assets from a Bloomberg Terminal, but I absolutely understand the trial of remembering my passwords.
paragraphs.zh: 史密森尼学会的美国国家历史博物馆收藏了多台彭博键盘，但我最喜欢的是编号 2014.0012.02 的藏品，它是「债券之王」比尔·格罗斯在二十世纪九十年代和二十一世纪初于太平洋投资管理公司使用的键盘。 格罗斯于 1971 年与他人共同创立了 PIMCO，并将其发展成一家资产达 2 万亿美元的债券投资公司。 我尤其喜欢的一点是，格罗斯把他的登录名和密码直接贴在键盘上，这让这件藏品更加亲切可感。 我可能永远不会知道通过彭博终端管理数十亿美元资产是什么感觉，但我完全能体会记住密码的苦恼。

paragraphs.en: Part of a continuing series looking at historical artifacts that embrace the boundless potential of technology.
paragraphs.zh: 这是探讨那些拥抱技术无限潜力的历史文物的系列文章之一。

paragraphs.en: An abridged version of this article appears in the October 2026 print issue as “The Keyboard That Moved Markets.”
paragraphs.zh: 本文的删节版刊载于2026年10月印刷版，标题为「撬动市场的键盘」。

paragraphs.en: References Bloomberg Professional Services has a nice timeline showing the evolution of its keyboards.
paragraphs.zh: 参考文献 彭博专业服务（Bloomberg Professional Services）有一个不错的时间线，展示了其键盘的演变过程。

paragraphs.en: For an economic analysis of how computers like the Bloomberg Terminal changed financial markets, see Gerben Bakker’s 2025 paper “ The Terminal Revolution: Reuters and Bloomberg as global providers of financial and economic news, 1960–2020 ,” published by the London School of Economics and Political Science.
paragraphs.zh: 关于彭博终端（Bloomberg Terminal）等计算机如何改变金融市场的经济分析，可参阅伦敦政治经济学院于2025年发表的论文《终端革命：路透社与彭博社作为全球金融与经济新闻提供商，1960–2020》（The Terminal Revolution: Reuters and Bloomberg as global providers of financial and economic news, 1960–2020），作者为格本·巴克尔（Gerben Bakker）。

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg Terminals are in the collections of many museums, including the Computer History Museum and the National Museum of American History .
paragraphs.zh: 彭博终端被许多博物馆收藏，包括计算机历史博物馆和美国国家历史博物馆。

paragraphs.en: Allison Marsh is a professor in Women and Gender Studies at the University of South Carolina and codirector of the university’s Ann Johnson Institute for Science, Technology & Society. She combines her interests in engineering, history, and museum objects to write the Past Forward column, which tells the story of technology through historical artifacts. Marsh is currently working on a book on the history of women in electrical engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 艾莉森·马什（Allison Marsh）是南卡罗来纳大学妇女与性别研究专业的教授，也是该校安·约翰逊科学、技术与社会研究所的联合主任。 她将自己对工程学、历史学和博物馆藏品的兴趣结合起来，撰写「Past Forward」专栏，通过历史文物讲述技术的故事。 马什目前正在撰写一本关于女性在电气工程领域历史的著作。

paragraphs.en: Fun fact: Bond King Bill Gross, whose Bloomberg Terminal keyboard (pictured above) is now in the Smithsonian’s National Museum of American History, has made a number of substantial donations to the Smithsonian over the years. In particular, he funded the stamp gallery that bears his name at the National Postal Museum in Washington, D.C. https://postalmuseum.si.edu/exhibition/william-h-gross-stamp-gallery
